title: apl_rogue.cpp
subtlety.simc
content:
actions.precombat=apply_poison
actions.precombat+=/snapshot_stats
actions.precombat+=/variable,name=priority_rotation,value=priority_rotation
# Check for on-use stat trinkets and which slot has the most powerful effect (ie longest cooldown).
actions.precombat+=/variable,name=trinket_sync_slot,value=1,if=trinket.1.has_use_buff&(!trinket.2.has_use_buff|trinket.1.cooldown.duration>=trinket.2.cooldown.duration)
actions.precombat+=/variable,name=trinket_sync_slot,value=2,if=trinket.2.has_use_buff&(!trinket.1.has_use_buff|trinket.2.cooldown.duration>trinket.1.cooldown.duration)
actions.precombat+=/stealth

actions=variable,name=stealth,value=buff.shadow_dance.up|buff.stealth.up|buff.vanish.up
actions+=/variable,name=targets,value=spell_targets.shuriken_storm
actions+=/variable,name=racial_sync,value=(buff.shadow_blades.up&buff.shadow_dance.up)|fight_remains<20
actions+=/variable,name=shd_cp,value=buff.slice_and_dice.up&combo_points<=2&talent.deathstalkers_mark|combo_points>=6&(!talent.deathstalkers_mark|variable.targets>=5)
actions+=/stealth
actions+=/call_action_list,name=race
actions+=/call_action_list,name=item
actions+=/call_action_list,name=cds
actions+=/shadowstrike,if=talent.ancient_arts_3&variable.targets<=2&(buff.darkest_night.up|(talent.unseen_blade&buff.supercharge_1.up))&buff.shadow_techniques.stack>=5&!buff.ancient_arts.up
actions+=/shuriken_storm,if=talent.ancient_arts_3&variable.targets>=3&(buff.supercharge_1.up)&buff.shadow_techniques.stack>=5&!buff.ancient_arts.up&!cooldown.secret_technique.ready
actions+=/call_action_list,name=finish,if=combo_points>=cp_max_spend-!buff.darkest_night.up
actions+=/call_action_list,name=build,if=variable.stealth|energy>60
actions+=/call_action_list,name=fill,if=!variable.stealth

# Cooldowns
# Delay the last Shadow Blades to line up with puzzle box if its equipped.
actions.cds=/shadow_blades,if=variable.shd_cp&cooldown.shadow_dance.charges_fractional>=1+0.8*talent.deathstalkers_mark&cooldown.secret_technique.ready&(fight_remains>90|!equipped.algethar_puzzle_box|trinket.1.proc.mastery.up|trinket.2.proc.mastery.up)|(fight_remains<=20|target.time_to_die.remains<=20)
actions.cds+=/shadow_dance,if=!variable.stealth&variable.shd_cp&energy>=30&((cooldown.secret_technique.ready|buff.darkest_night.up)&(cooldown.shadow_blades.remains>=30-cooldown.secret_technique.duration)|(buff.shadow_blades.up&cooldown.secret_technique.duration>=18))|(fight_remains<=10|target.time_to_die-remains<=9)
# Have the second Shadow Dance in Shadow Blades line up with the end of Shadow Blades instead of back-to-back for trickster.
actions.cds+=/shadow_dance,if=buff.shadow_blades.up&talent.unseen_blade&buff.shadow_blades.remains<=buff.shadow_dance.duration+1
# Used for when Shadow Blades is ready but holding for Algethar Puzzlebox trinket at the end of pull
actions.cds+=/shadow_dance,if=equipped.algethar_puzzle_box&talent.unseen_blade&!variable.stealth&variable.shd_cp&energy>=30&((cooldown.secret_technique.ready|buff.darkest_night.up)&(trinket.algethar_puzzle_box.cooldown.remains>=39-30*cooldown.shadow_blades.up))
actions.cds+=/vanish,if=!variable.stealth&energy>=50&!buff.subterfuge.up&combo_points<=2
actions.cds+=/shadowmeld,if=energy>=50&!variable.stealth&combo_points.deficit>=2

# Race Cooldowns
actions.race=blood_fury,if=variable.racial_sync
actions.race+=/berserking,if=variable.racial_sync
actions.race+=/fireblood,if=variable.racial_sync
actions.race+=/ancestral_call,if=variable.racial_sync
actions.race+=/invoke_external_buff,name=power_infusion,if=variable.racial_sync

# Trinket and Items
actions.item=potion,if=buff.shadow_blades.up|fight_remains<30
actions.item+=/use_item,name=algethar_puzzle_box,if=cooldown.shadow_blades.ready&cooldown.secret_technique.remains<=2&combo_points>=6
actions.item+=/use_items,slots=trinket1,if=(variable.trinket_sync_slot=1&(buff.shadow_blades.up|fight_remains<=20)|(variable.trinket_sync_slot=2&(!trinket.2.cooldown.ready&cooldown.shadow_blades.remains>20))|!variable.trinket_sync_slot)
actions.item+=/use_items,slots=trinket2,if=(variable.trinket_sync_slot=2&(buff.shadow_blades.up|fight_remains<=20)|(variable.trinket_sync_slot=1&(!trinket.1.cooldown.ready&cooldown.shadow_blades.remains>20))|!variable.trinket_sync_slot)

actions.finish=eviscerate,if=buff.darkest_night.up
actions.finish+=/secret_technique,if=buff.shadow_dance.up|(cooldown.secret_technique.duration<18|cooldown.shadow_dance.remains>=10)&!cooldown.shadow_dance.ready
actions.finish+=/coup_de_grace,if=cooldown.secret_technique.remains>=3|buff.shadow_dance.up
actions.finish+=/black_powder,if=variable.targets>=3
# Pool some Shadow Technique Stacks before entering Shadow Dance by not finishing right before.
actions.finish+=/eviscerate,if=cooldown.secret_technique.remains>=3&talent.unseen_blade|buff.shadow_dance.up|buff.shadow_blades.up|debuff.deathstalkers_mark.stack>1|debuff.deathstalkers_mark.stack=1&buff.shadow_techniques.stack>=5

actions.build=shuriken_storm,if=prev.shadow_dance&buff.premeditation.up&talent.danse_macabre
actions.build+=/shadowstrike,if=!debuff.deathstalkers_mark.up&talent.deathstalkers_mark&!buff.darkest_night.up|variable.targets<=3|variable.priority_rotation
actions.build+=/shuriken_storm,if=variable.targets>1
actions.build+=/goremaws_bite,if=combo_points.deficit>=3
actions.build+=/gloomblade,if=variable.targets<2&!variable.stealth
actions.build+=/backstab,if=variable.targets<2&!variable.stealth

# This list usually contains Cooldowns with negligible impact that causes global cooldowns
actions.fill=arcane_torrent,if=energy.deficit>=15+energy.regen
actions.fill+=/arcane_pulse
actions.fill+=/lights_judgment
actions.fill+=/bag_of_tricks

The pros are that you can spam one button for your finishers in AoE aside from secret technique, and you will never miss a use of Coup de Grace. Like you'll always use it on cool down, which is always good. The cons, however, are that very rarely it may be correct to not use your Coup de Grace and hold it for a more opportune time, maybe one or two finishers later. And if you use a macro like this, you don't have the ability to do that. Or if you're ever out of melee range, you'll not be able to use Black Powder as it's being locked behind your Coup de Grace. So, you'll just stand there not doing anything. Now, you can solve this with another separate keybind that only has Black Powder on it, but that's something you would have to then set up. So, use it if you want. It's up to you. Uh talents. Uh now, I have some strings here. Obviously, you can't copy paste these yourselves. I'll include these in the video description below if you want to check them out. These two in particular, I just unioned from the Ravenholdt Discord. I'm not going to spend more time going over our talents. The talent tree, despite looking pretty vast and full of things you can move around, options that you have to choose between, it's sort of illusion of choice. You'll just end up playing what does the most damage, and most of the stuff here doesn't interact with your damaging rotation. The vast majority of talent nodes are just passive damage effects, so I don't think it's worth going into detail. For stats then, we have a nice infographic made by Fu, uh which doesn't include agility, which I thought I would mention is your best stat, by the way, by a long margin, especially at the start of the expansion here. Any primary stat you can get is likely your biggest immediate upgrade. Beyond that, the goal is to hit a haste breakpoint of about 18%. Uh this is true for both single target and AoE, and then gear according to the different damage profiles. So, for single target, we really like mastery and crits, and then in AoE, we really want mastery, and that's pretty much it. And as always, I'd highly recommend it simming for yourself on Raidbots to identify what the best upgrades for you will be. Just because these stat breakdowns exist doesn't mean you should blindly gear in this direction. I guarantee, if you care enough about it, there are ways you can add damage to your character by simming it for yourself and seeing what items you can move around to maximize your damage. And that's it. Thanks for watching. Hope you enjoyed. Uh I've attached a couple references for places you can go if you are looking for some more information. The Ravenholdt Discord is a great place, Wowhead Sub Rogue guide, um Raidbots, of course, and big thanks to Fu and Alim for the work they do in the Rogue community, and specifically for the Sub Rogue side of things. Yeah. See you in the next one.

Subtlety Rogue Rotation in
The rotation for Subtlety Rogue is based on cooldowns combined with two resources you need to manage. The basis is a builder-and-spender system, where combo point builders generate combo points. Finishers are used to consume these combo points when close to the maximum amount (6 or 7 combo points). Energy is the limiting resource most of the time, and it's completely normal to feel resource-starved. Cooldowns allow you to accelerate the cycle and give access to stronger builders, creating a damage profile with serious damage during cooldowns and very low outside.
Resource economy:
Energy and Combo Point income varies a lot on Subtlety, the generation of both resources is low outside of cooldowns but high during. The passive talent
Shadow Techniques
is responsible for a big part of the income; this makes staying within auto attack range essential in both single target and AoE situations. The pacing outside of cooldowns can feel slow as a result.
Cooldown Management:
The vast majority of damage is bound to cooldowns, offering Subtlety the unique opportunity to stack them. All cooldowns are aligned to
Secret Technique
, which means we only use
Shadow Dance
when the spell is ready. Our major cooldown
Shadow Blades
is used alongside
Shadow Dance
when possible, and a second instance of
Shadow Dance
is typically used right after the first ended (the second cast won't have
Secret Technique
ready). Cooldowns don't line up well naturally, which often means we delay both
Secret Technique
and
Shadow Dance
slightly when
Shadow Blades
is about to come off cooldown.
Global Cooldown Efficiency:
All of Subtleties damage is in Cooldowns, which means utilizing every second becomes essential. Make sure not to cast
Shadow Dance
during a global cooldown and use your first ability as soon as possible after. This is important because of the
Deepening Shadows
talent, which can extend the duration of
Shadow Dance
just enough to fit another spell. Any small delay can lead to a loss here. A common strategy to prevent this is the use of a macro that combines the cooldown with a combo point builder or spender.

Subtlety Rogue Major Cooldowns
Subtlety has access to a variety of different cooldowns. All of them come with some extra wrinkles in how they work rather than simply being flat increases, so the below section covers
how

Secret Technique‎
Secret Technique
is a finishing move that's split in three parts, and is the only cooldown on Subtlety that has a static cooldown, which is reduced by haste. The following information is good to know:
Optimal Use
The optimal use of
Secret Technique
is during
Shadow Dance
as soon as possible.
Shadow Dance

is the defining cooldown of Subtlety and allows the use of
Stealth

Optimal Use
You always want to use
Shadow Dance
with either very low combo points or finishing combo points.
- Prefers to start

with low combo points.
- Prefers to start
Shadow Dance
with finishing combo points.
Only use it if

Shadow Blades

Use with
Shadow Blades
with
Shadow Dance

This is a fall back option to re-apply

When using this macro, always make sure to be on 6 or 7 combo points before using

The reason we use

Shadowstrike

A good way to test if you need this macro or not is to play your rotation on a target dummy, if you notice barely missing your last cast in
Shadow Dance

Shadowstrike

Not using finishers generates additional stacks of
Shadow Techniques

Doing so also reduces potential delays introduced by building up combo points when playing (So you can use
Shadow Dance
and
Secret Technique

The apex talents procs when you have 5+ stacks of Shadow Techniques. You don't want to empower Secret Technique because of how it interacts with the Apex talents.

Two-target cleave is a special case. Using
Eviscerate
instead of
Black Powder
is stronger when you are not talented in
Potent Powder

Black Powder
is stronger on 3+ targets, and as such, the default choice on most encounters with adds/multi-target cleave.
Delaying your second
Shadow Dance
allows it to fit
Secret Technique
in it, increasing your overall output.
The mentioned optimization is reliable and easy to perform; you can squeeze out just another minimal increase by doing the following:
You want to have supercharger on both casts of
Secret Technique
during
Shadow Blades
. This means delaying your second
Shadow Dance
till
Secret Technique

The best trinkets for single target are on-use trinkets; the best ones are tricky to use.
The list below outlines the use of the specific trinkets:
Light Company Guidon
,
Emberwing Feather

Deepening Shadows
works. The duration is only updated in intervals of one second, which has a risk of losing the benefits when used with
Shadow Dance
.
Algeth'ar Puzzle Box

The most likely trinket to use in Mythic+ is
Algeth'ar Puzzle Box
. The trinket has a two-second channel, and as such, it is best to be used before major cooldowns. This means using the trinket after Shadow Strike before going into cooldown. The trinket is used as if the cooldown is 3 minutes.

The
Wowhead Client
is a little application we use to keep our database up to date, and to provide you with some nifty extra functionality on the website!
It serves 2 main purposes:
It maintains a WoW addon called the
Wowhead Looter
, which collects data as you play the game!
It uploads the
collected data
to Wowhead in order to keep the database up-to-date!
You can also use it to keep track of your completed quests, recipes, mounts, companion pets, and titles!
So, what are you waiting for?
Download the client
and get started.
